events.title: All Set and Ready for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hello everyone, after daily updates—one version per day—the median playtime for players has now reached 26 minutes, and the average playtime is over an hour. It’s already in a fairly polished state, and we’re just waiting for players to show up (are they here yet?). events.title: Improved Enemy Spawning for More Balanced Combat
events.summary: Hello everyone! After two weeks of updates, the Full Metal Hell demo has changed dramatically. A huge thank you to everyone who has tried the game and shared feedback—your input makes these improvements possible! Here's what's new in today's update: Improved enemy spawning Enemies will no longer bunch up when they accumulate. Instead, they'll respawn based on the player's position. New enemy: Missile Trooper A new ranged enemy that spawns in small numbers and fires missiles from beyond your view

events.title: Major Demo Update
events.summary: Added a player color indicator to help you spot yourself in chaotic battles.Fixed various bugs.Updated key bindings.Supply crates can now be destroyed by ramming them.Added new scaling items.Switched to a new vehicle: the hovercraft.

events.title: Demo Update!
events.summary: Thank you all for playing and for your feedback! Once we started hearing directly from players, we began improving the game faster than ever.This update includes:Added a new player tutorialRebalanced game valuesImproved combat impact and feedbackAdded more sound effectsFixed various bugsImproved localization for Latin-script languages
